name: Jet Fuel
summary: **Jet Fuel** is a [[kind:cultivar|hybrid]] bred by 303 Seeds in Colorado, crossing [[aspen-og|Aspen OG]] with [[high-country-diesel|High Country Diesel]]. The G6 alias originated with the breeder, and Jet Fuel and Jet Fuel OG denote the same cut. It differs from [[jet-fuel-gelato|Jet Fuel Gelato]], a later cross adding Gelato lineage.
